title: Alphabet的TPU芯片在上个季度首次创造了营收。以下是为什么这一项目比头条新闻中的云业务数据更重要的原因。
content:
Alphabet's TPU Chips Generated Revenue for the First Time Last Quarter. Here's Why That Line Item Matters More Than the Headline Cloud Number.
There's no denying that Alphabet's (NASDAQ: GOOG)(NASDAQ: GOOGL) cloud computing results were the centerpiece of the company's recently posted second-quarter report. This business unit's revenue improved by a whopping 82% year over year, more than tripling its operating income as a result.
As encouraging as that is, however, perhaps it's not the most exciting leap Google's parent company made during the three months ending in June. Far more important was the fact that -- for the first time ever -- the company's so-called Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) were also directly monetized, officially putting Alphabet in the chipmaking business.
Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »
Alphabet is in the right place at the right time
Nvidia remains the leading designer of artificial intelligence processors. But several technology giants with the capabilities of designing their own, often in partnership with players like Broadcom -- are doing so. Alphabet's one of them. Its Tensor Processing Units were initially used strictly in-house, with capacity leased to clients via Google Cloud. But now, some are being shipped to data centers operated by third parties.
We don't know how much revenue these chips actually produced last quarter, although it likely wasn't a great deal. All we know is that these sales were reflected within the company's Q2 cloud computing revenue of $24.8 billion, which, as was noted, grew 82% year over year.
Nevertheless, look for an increasingly bigger impact from TPUs going forward.
See, the AI industry has only scratched the surface of establishing the infrastructure it thinks it will eventually need. Technology industry research outfit Technavio expects the worldwide artificial intelligence chip business's annual revenue to grow at an average annual pace of more than 24% between now and 2030, when it will be $155 billion bigger than it is now. That growth outlook jibes with Global Market Insights' projection, which is calling for $1.1 trillion worth of annual artificial intelligence chip sales by 2035.
Already a well-proven cloud technology name, Alphabet is positioned to capture at least its fair share of this growth.
Bolstering the bullish case
It's not a reason in and of itself to own Alphabet stock. The lion's share of the company's sales and operating income still comes from its market-leading search engine, and for the time being, most of its cloud computing revenue reflects rented access to its service and apps rather than revenue stemming from sales of Tensor Processing Units. And with Google Cloud's backlog of future business growing by $50 billion to $514 billion as of the end of Q2 (and Q2's total revenue of $119.8 billion, for perspective), that's not apt to change in the immediate future. That's even more so the case given that the company's current supply of TPU chips is being rationed between external customers and internal use.

report.summary: Alphabet的TPU芯片首次直接创收，标志着其正式进入芯片销售业务。
report.background: Alphabet长期以来通过Google Cloud出租自家TPU算力，但芯片本身并未单独出售。2025年Q2，TPU首次作为产品直接销售给第三方数据中心，并计入云业务收入。这一转变发生在AI芯片需求爆发、Nvidia主导市场的背景下，Alphabet正试图通过自研芯片在AI基础设施领域分得一杯羹，同时缓解对Nvidia的依赖。
key_points: Alphabet的TPU芯片在Q2首次直接产生营收，虽然金额未披露，但由内部使用转为对外销售，标志其正式进入芯片销售市场。
Google Cloud Q2营收同比增长82%，达到248亿美元，其中TPU销售贡献了部分增量，但云服务仍是主要收入来源。
AI芯片市场预计到2030年年增长超24%，Alphabet希望借助TPU在AI基础设施扩张中占据一席之地。
TPU供应目前需在外部客户和内部使用之间分配，短期内销售规模可能受限，但长期增长潜力可期。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，TPU对外销售打破Nvidia在AI芯片市场的垄断，提供更多硬件选择。对开发者来说，可能意味着更便宜的AI算力和更多云端TPU实例。对普通用户，未来AI服务成本有望降低，但短期影响有限。Alphabet的转型也表明大型云厂商正从单纯卖算力转向软硬一体布局。
report.tools: 关注Google Cloud TPU官方文档、TensorFlow/PyTorch对TPU的支持。开源项目推荐JAX（专为TPU优化）、XLA编译器。硬件爱好者可关注Broadcom与Alphabet的定制芯片合作动态。
